_comment: Worked example: a 15s 9:16 promo reel for a school's 30th anniversary, cut from a 3-minute 16:9 drone video. Shape: an archival photo of the old gate held 2.8s under a vintage grade, a white flash into the present day, then clips that get shorter and grades that get richer so the back half accelerates. Every range was taken from a clean stretch reported by scan_source.py — the source has 152 dip-to-black samples in it.
